request.spec:
A change that alters any person's overdue-total is now also followed by the rollup lines, and
every ROLLUP line gains overdue-total=<overdue-total> at its end, every TOTALS line
overdue-total=<total> at its end (a TOTALS line is written when any of its three totals moved).
A change of the sheet's today that puts a claim past its due-by, or takes one out of overdue, is
such a change even when no due or due-total moved.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
A change that alters any person's overdue-total is now also followed by the rollup lines, and
every ROLLUP line gains overdue-total=<overdue-total> at its end, every TOTALS line
overdue-total=<total> at its end (a TOTALS line is written when any of its three totals moved).

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.

agent.result_text:
ROLLUP and TOTALS audit lines now end with `overdue-total=…`, and a change that moves anyone's overdue-total writes them too. `bin/e2e` passes all 4 acceptance tests.

Until now the overdue figures were only calculated in the browser, so I added the same calculation to the server, in `Rollup.java` and `Snapshot.java`:

- **Per person:** each person's overdue-total adds up the dues (late charges included) of their claims that count, are still OPEN or PENDING, and have a due-by before the sheet's today. Claims with no figure (n/a) are skipped.
- **Sheet total:** the TOTALS overdue-total adds up everyone's overdue-totals.
- **When a ROLLUP line is written:** when a person's claimed, due-total or overdue-total changed (a new person still always gets one).
- **When a TOTALS line is written:** when any of its three totals changed.

The today endpoint already took a before-and-after snapshot of the figures. So moving today so that a claim goes past its due-by, or stops being overdue, now writes the rollup lines even when no due or due-total changed.

Nothing changed on the front end: the overdue values on screen were already shown.
